rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but it overstates quality as 'good-to-excellent' and A-grade TE/compact ICM are not clearly supported by this image, which appears somewhat less expanded and with less distinct ICM/TE detail.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, endometrium, semen, BMI, lifestyle, and cycle history well, with appropriate emphasis on age-related aneuploidy as the main limiting factor.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent overall, linking morphology and patient factors to prognosis; only minor issue is somewhat optimistic interpretation of morphology relative to the image.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice guidelines: single embryo transfer, standard luteal support, no bed rest, cautious discussion of PGT-A, and not overinterpreting one failed transfer.
Provides practical next steps for transfer, follow-up, and future planning, though some recommendations remain somewhat general rather than highly case-specific.
